goal: Let separate processes query chain data and receive events over IPC
Unblock running the wallet in its own process without freezing internal APIs
agreement: Broad concept and testing support across multiple external prototypes (darosior, Sjors, willcl-ark, enirox001)
Verified by exercising stable methods, reorgs, and schema compatibility (enirox001)
Tested with a Rust BDK wallet client proof of concept (darosior)
Unaddressed objection: node aborts if a client errors during notification callbacks (xyzconstant)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it directly advances running bitcoin-wallet in an isolated process
Provides a backward-compatible stable API for external consumers without freezing internal node methods
Enables out-of-process indexes and custom clients to query chain state and follow events
